articleranking:
{{doc-special|ArticleRanking}}
The title of the report page that lists vote totals per page.
ranking-section1-title: Heading of the voting section shown at the bottom of an article, asking whether the page helped the reader.
ranking-yes:
Label of the button that casts a positive vote.
{{Identical|Yes}}
ranking-no:
Label of the button that casts a negative vote.
{{Identical|No}}
ranking-section2-title: Heading of the second part of the voting section, which offers to share the page or report a problem with it.
ranking-propose-change: Label of the link that opens the change-request form for the page.
ranking-vote-success: Message shown in the voting section after a vote was recorded.
ranking-vote-fail: Message shown in the voting section when a vote could not be recorded; the reader can vote again.
after-vote-button:
Label of the button that sends the optional message written after a vote.
{{Identical|Send}}
voting-messages-positive-placeholder: Placeholder of the text box shown after a positive vote, inviting the reader to add a message.
voting-messages-negative-placeholder: Placeholder of the text box shown after a negative vote, asking the reader why the page did not help.
ranking-invalid-captcha-title: Title of an error about the CAPTCHA.
ranking-invalid-captcha-keys-message: Error shown when the CAPTCHA site key or secret is not configured.
article-ranking-after-vote-failed: Shown in a dialog when the message written after a vote could not be sent.
article-ranking-after-vote-success: Shown under the after-vote form once the message was sent.
article-ranking-after-vote-OK:
Label of the button that closes the dialog shown when the after-vote message could not be sent.
{{Identical|OK}}
articleranking-filter-legend:
Legend of the filter form on [[Special:ArticleRanking]].
{{Identical|Filter}}
articleranking-filter-title:
Label of the filter field on [[Special:ArticleRanking]] that limits the report to one page.
{{Identical|Page}}
articleranking-page-title:
Column header on [[Special:ArticleRanking]]: the page that was voted on.
{{Identical|Page}}
articleranking-sum-negative: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRanking]]: the number of negative votes.
articleranking-sum-negative-percent: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRanking]]: the share of negative votes, as a percentage. Shown next to {{msg-mw|articleranking-sum-negative}}.
articleranking-sum-positive: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRanking]]: the number of positive votes.
articleranking-sum-positive-percent: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRanking]]: the share of positive votes, as a percentage. Shown next to {{msg-mw|articleranking-sum-positive}}.
articleranking-sum-total: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRanking]]: the total number of votes.
articleranking-filter-min-ranknigs: Label of the filter field on [[Special:ArticleRanking]] that hides pages with fewer votes than the number entered.
articleranking-filter-content-area: Label of the filter field on [[Special:ArticleRanking]] that limits the report to one content area. Shown only when the ArticleContentArea extension is installed.
articleranking-tableheader-content-area: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRanking]]: the content area of the page. Shown only when the ArticleContentArea extension is installed.
article-ranking-special-feedback: Title of [[Special:ArticleRankingFeedback]], which lists the messages readers wrote after voting.
article-ranking-feedbacklist-title: Label of the page filter on [[Special:ArticleRankingFeedback]], and header of its page column.
article-ranking-feedbacklist-text: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRankingFeedback]]: the message the reader wrote.
article-ranking-feedbacklist-vote: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRankingFeedback]]: whether the vote was positive or negative.
article-ranking-feedbacklist-timestamp: Column header on [[Special:ArticleRankingFeedback]]: when the message was sent.
articlerankingfeedback:
{{doc-special|ArticleRankingFeedback}}
Also the legend of the filter form on that page.
article-ranking-feedbacklist-submit:
Label of the submit button of the filter form on [[Special:ArticleRankingFeedback]].
{{Identical|Filter}}
article-ranking-feedbacklist-no-results: Shown on [[Special:ArticleRankingFeedback]] when no message matches the filter.
